title: Privacy information
status: Information screen; full policy review outstanding

sections.title: Your account
sections.text: Peep uses account details such as your email, display name and avatar to provide account features. Watch history and My List are shared by viewers on the same account.

sections.title: Viewing activity
sections.text: Peep stores viewing progress to resume videos. Live TV activity includes viewing sessions, channel identifiers, viewing time and an app-generated device identifier for reporting.

sections.title: Advertising and playback
sections.text: Peep uses third-party hosting and advertising services to deliver video and ads. Requests to those services include network information. Peep records ad requests, starts, completions and errors; advertising providers also perform their own tracking.

sections.title: On this Apple TV
sections.text: Playback preferences, your last viewer selection and the ad-frequency timestamp are saved on this device. Signing out does not delete your Peep account.

sections.title: Privacy questions
sections.text: For privacy questions or an account-data deletion request, contact privacy@watchpeep.tv. This is a contact option, not an in-app account-deletion flow.
